summary: Comprehensive regression test after multi-iteration feature additions. Backend endpoints all healthy (notifications, lead-suppliers, dashboard summary, webhooks/resend, auth). Frontend mostly working — Google button, bell notifications, draggable KPIs, Supplier Operations summary, Calendar, dynamic child ages, and duplicate detection all confirmed. CRITICAL: LeadDetail page crashes with a runtime error because SupplierTracker component is used but not imported — the entire Supplier Response Tracker feature is inaccessible from the UI.
passed: GET /api/notifications returns 200 with reply_received alert for IR07004
GET /api/lead-suppliers/IR07004 returns tracker rows with sequence, status, hours_since_email
Login page shows 'Continue with Google' button (data-testid=google-login visible)
Admin login → dashboard renders. 8 draggable KPI cards present, 'Reset layout' button visible, supplier-summary card renders with all metrics + Fastest Responders row
Bell button clickable, bell popover opens with 1 alert (reply_received for IR07004)
Calendar page renders month grid, cal-day-* cells present
New Lead form: children field triggers child-ages-section; f-child-age-0 and f-child-age-1 render when children=2
Duplicate detection: phone +91-9876543210 shows amber 'Possible duplicate — 1 existing lead(s) match' warning card listing IR07001 (Aarav Test/Bali). Submit remains allowed.
Ops user login → dashboard shows supplier-summary card

failed.issue: LeadDetail.jsx line 273 uses <SupplierTracker leadId={lead.lead_id} leadPhone={lead.phone} /> but the component is NEVER imported. Result: 'ReferenceError: SupplierTracker is not defined' — entire /leads/:id page crashes with the Uncaught Runtime Errors overlay. Supplier Response Tracker feature (sequence #, status pill, hours-since-email, follow-up counter, quote amount, Bell/Email/Call/WhatsApp/Update actions, Update dialog with Quote Received checkbox + amount validation) is COMPLETELY UNREACHABLE from the UI.
failed.evidence: Console: ReferenceError: SupplierTracker is not defined at LeadDetail (bundle.js:9461:91). Screenshot shows red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay. grep confirms LeadDetail.jsx imports list (lines 1–15) contains no reference to SupplierTracker.

failed.issue: Sales user can call GET /api/suppliers and receive 200. Task states sales must NOT access /suppliers. Frontend sidebar hides it, but the API endpoint itself is not restricted for sales role.
failed.evidence: curl with sales JWT → HTTP 200 on /api/suppliers.

action_items: HIGH: Add `import SupplierTracker from '@/components/app/SupplierTracker';` to /app/frontend/src/pages/LeadDetail.jsx (top of file). Verify LeadDetail renders the tracker card at the bottom of the page and Update dialog works with Quote Received checkbox + amount validation.
MEDIUM: Add role guard on GET /api/suppliers to restrict sales role (or clarify intent — spec says sales cannot access it).

RETEST: Once import is added, retest the full Supplier Response Tracker flow — sequence, status pill color coding, Update dialog with amount validation, and verify status flips to 'Quote Received' (emerald).
